site.name: larkfit-mobile
site.summary: larkfit-mobile Fictional fitness tracker "Lark" iOS-style mobile fixture. UXBench fixture in the Mobile Micro-UI category. Layout - 390 × 844 phone frame with chrome bezel, notch, status bar, home indicator - Bottom 4-tab bar: Today / Workouts / Activity / You - Edge-to-edge on actual mobile (≤460 px) Screens | `data-screen` | Highlights |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the larkfit-mobile fitness tracker, validating all tab screens, interactive states, and mobile responsiveness.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will systematically navigate through the four primary bottom-tab screens (Today, Workouts, Activity, You) to validate layout, state changes, and interactive controls. It will then deep-dive into specific interactions like workout details, adding new data, and toggling preferences. Finally, the entire flow will be validated on a mobile viewport to assess edge-to-edge behavior and tap target issues flagged in the prescan.
assumptions: The app is a single-page application (SPA) where tab buttons and other controls manipulate the DOM (likely via `data-screen` attributes) rather than loading new HTML files.
The '+' button and '▶' workout buttons trigger modals, dialogs, or detailed screen overlays.
The 2 detected inputs are located within the 'You' or 'Activity' screens for user preferences or data logging.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets: The '+' (38x38px) and '▶' (36x36px) buttons fail the 44px mobile guidance and may cause touch errors on actual devices.
Workout detail state: Clicking '▶' on 'Easy 5K' or 'Hip-mobility flow' may trigger complex state changes or overlays that require dismissal.
Mobile viewport transition: The layout shifts from a 390x844 phone frame with bezel to edge-to-edge on widths ≤460px, which may break layout or overlap content.

phases.title: Explore Today Screen
phases.objective: Validate the default 'Today' screen layout, data visualization, and initial interactions.
key_checks: Verify the 'Today' tab is active and its metrics (MOVE, EXERCISE, STAND, steps, etc.) are visible.
Click the 'All workouts →' link/button to check navigation to the Workouts screen or list expansion.
Click the '+' button and verify the outcome (e.g., modal, new screen, or input focus).
Dismiss any opened overlay to return to the default state.
exit_criteria: All visible elements on the 'Today' screen have been inspected.
The '+' button interaction has been triggered and its state validated.

phases.title: Explore Workouts Screen
phases.objective: Validate the 'Workouts' tab, workout list, and workout detail interactions.
key_checks: Click the '▶ Workouts' tab and verify the screen transition and active tab state.
Inspect the workout list and click the '▶' button on 'Easy 5K — recovery pace'.
Validate the workout detail view (Plan, You'll need, etc.) and check for layout issues.
Dismiss the detail view and repeat for 'Hip-mobility flow'.
exit_criteria: Both workout '▶' buttons have been clicked and their detail states validated and dismissed.

phases.title: Explore Activity Screen
phases.objective: Validate the 'Activity' tab, data visualizations, and 30-day intensity metrics.
key_checks: Click the '📊 Activity' tab and verify screen transition.
Inspect the '30-day intensity' chart/graph and 'Recent' activity list.
Interact with any visible controls or inputs specific to the Activity screen.
exit_criteria: Visual data elements and recent items have been inspected.

phases.title: Explore You Screen
phases.objective: Validate the 'You' profile tab, connected apps, and preference inputs.
key_checks: Click the '◉ You' tab and verify screen transition.
Locate and interact with the 2 detected inputs (likely under 'Preferences' or 'Connected').
Toggle any switches or modify input values to test state persistence and validation.
exit_criteria: Both inputs have been interacted with and their behaviors validated.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-test critical flows and layout shifts on a mobile viewport (≤460px).
key_checks: Switch viewport to mobile (e.g., 390x844) and verify edge-to-edge layout and bezel/notch disappearance.
Navigate back through all 4 tabs to check for broken layouts or overlapping elements.
Re-evaluate the small tap targets ('+' and '▶' buttons) for usability on the mobile viewport.
Trigger a workout detail view on mobile to ensure overlays adapt correctly.
exit_criteria: All 4 tabs have been visited on the mobile viewport.
Layout transition from framed to edge-to-edge is validated.
Tap target usability has been critiqued.

coverage_targets.features: Interact with all 4 tab screens, both detected inputs, and all small tap target buttons ('+', '▶')
coverage_targets.mobile: Validate all 4 tab screens and 1 overlay/detail state on mobile viewport

notes: Pay close attention to the DOM changes when navigating tabs, as the site uses a single HTML file with likely JS-driven screen switching.
Document any layout breakage when transitioning to the edge-to-edge mobile view, especially around the status bar and home indicator areas.
